supplemental_items.interpretation: Validate timeframe first. Supplied indexes' time arrays are selected by nonnull identity and aliased; lower_index itself chosen later by truthiness. No local identity validation of supplied indexes; caller must establish consistency. Cache maps initialized fresh.

supplemental_items.interpretation: MarketChronology main_index differs from DetectorBase: upper bound minus one, only left guard and optional clamp; no last-end guard. Empty with clamp returns zero. Lower bounds half-open, null end current sequence length, slice native; no sorting or bound normalization.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of assignment, provenance, guard order, fallback or lifetime beyond category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Reset and confirmation keys preserve native string representations and exact field order; Reset defaults differ by field. findings.description: Previous prose conflated nonnull time-array selection and truthiness of lower-index selection, and omitted lack of local prepared-index identity validation.
findings.resolution: Require timeframe_seconds>=1. Retain sequences; alias prepared main/lower times by nonnull test, else build. Timeframe timedelta; choose lower index by truthiness (false-valued supplied index falls back to shared index even though its times were selected by nonnull test); store main range index. No local supplied-index identity validation. Empty confirmation/reset/E main extremes caches.
